objective: Remove the misleading restart/apply-later banner and silently fetch compatible Expo OTA updates for next normal cold start, preserving active user activity and mandatory native APK version enforcement.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main and consolidated staging integration both still have the same manual I-restart/Mamaya OTA banner. Exact production-served Android EAS update/build and installed-device adoption are unverified. No production OTA, release marker, backend, or Season 1/2 reward change is authorized here.
chosenApproach: Retain Expo built-in ON_LOAD check and next-cold-start activation. Replace native banner with invisible lifecycle host and testable bounded downloader, stagger checks on foreground returns, dedupe downloads, fail silently with cooldown. Never reload during calls/PTT/posts or pending offline submissions.
selectionRationale: No native dependency change; eliminates confusing user-visible restart warning. Expo documented next-cold-start activation is safer than inferring whether ongoing work is safe to interrupt. Low network overhead and dedicated regression tests protect release behavior.
alternativeApproaches: Run Updates.reloadAsync automatically: rejected as it may interrupt calls/PTT, drafts, uploads and offline submissions.
Keep the banner with renamed buttons: rejected as it preserves a misleading forced-action prompt.
Create an OS background service/native build: rejected as unnecessary for compatible OTA-only behavior.
